newsitem.title: USA: Sure Shot says Isaiah Thomas to be chairman.
newsitem.headline: Sure Shot says Isaiah Thomas to be chairman.

text.p: Sure Shot International Inc. said Monday that former Detroit Pistons star Isaiah Thomas has agreed to buy a majority stake in the company, a maker of basketball equipment, and become its chairman.

Thomas, part owner of the Toronto Raptors professional basketball team and its general manager, is forming a group that will invest $1.5 million in cash to buy 4.5 million shares of Sure Shot's common stock, the company said.
The company said Thomas and the new group also would have the potential to buy up to 1 million additional shares.
As chairman, Thomas would succeed Harry Bachmann, who would remain president of the company.
Sure Shot stock jumped 62.5 cents to $2.50 on Nasdaq, where it was one of the biggest percentage gainers of the session.
